name: Ibrar Arshad
headline: Software Generalist
summary:
I am an experienced tech generalist with multiple years of experience as a software engineer.


I have a master's degree in Computer Science from TUM with a mix of focus on Distributed systems, and Machine Learning, especially the application of Deep Learning for CV and NLP tasks. My experiences during the last 3-4 years include being part of a startup incubator(EF), working in a very inter-disciplinary setting to get an honors degree in technology management at CDTM , and working in various engineering roles at multiple startups.

Prior to masters, I worked for 2,5 years at Xgrid, the Pakistan based office of PLUMGRID U.S. At Xgrid, I started a team which was twin to the team in US, and was responsible for designing and developing the core of an OpenStack based  SDN solution. 

I am well versed in Deep Learning, backend development, cloud, and distributed systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
AWS-Based IoT Platform for Parking Lot Management: Key Contributions

- Kafka Event Broker: Designed and maintained an AWS MSK-based Kafka cluster as a central event broker for microservices. Optimized memory, disk space, and replication strategies for high availability. Managed ACLs and fine-tuned producer/consumer settings for efficiency. Conducted team training for Kafka integration and developed monitoring services with Elastic logs, watchers, and Google notifications.

- Resilient Event Processing: Developed a microservice to process events from an MQTT broker, storing them in Kafka with an SQS-based backup for downtime resilience. Performed throughput analysis and integrated unit and integration tests using frameworks like Moto3 and unittest to ensure production readiness.

- Custom Health Checks: Built ECS-specific health checks covering multithreaded and multiprocess services, using file-based mechanisms for comprehensive validation. Enhanced logging via Elastic REST API and FluentBit, enabling real-time alerts with Elastic watchers and Google notifications.

- Service Metrics and Monitoring: Established detailed metrics for microservices, including events produced/processed, database writes, and processing times. Designed Kibana dashboards for real-time monitoring.

- Infrastructure Automation: Managed Terraform repositories to provision AWS resources (IAM roles, ECS clusters, ECR repositories, Secrets Manager). Delivered secure and scalable deployment pipelines.

- Serverless API Development: Built serverless APIs with AWS Lambda, integrating with Hasura actions for seamless front-end interaction. Optimized performance by replacing GraphQL queries with direct SQL connections to reduce latency.

- CI/CD Pipelines: Developed Docker images for Python microservices and GitLab pipelines for dynamic deployment, restart, and scaling of ECS services.

- Kafka Configuration Tooling: Python-based tool to streamline Kafka topic and ACL management.
